topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: When I found out that my childhood best friend doesn’t remember me, it felt like a piece of my past had slipped away, silent and unnoticed. It’s strange, the way memories hold us together, or so we think. I remember everything—our secret hideouts, the way we’d share our dreams like they were the most precious things in the world. But now, it’s just me with those memories. I’ve thought about reaching out, but what do you say to someone who’s forgotten a part of their own story? Maybe, just maybe, I’ll tell them about those days, let them see a piece of their past through my eyes. Sometimes, even forgotten memories can become new beginnings.
